system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Global crisis attribution to single conflict",
    "detail": "Attributing worldwide economic problems directly to one specific war without acknowledging other contributing factors.",
    "debias": "When discussing economic impacts, acknowledge multiple contributing factors rather than single-cause attribution.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-13",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Factory workers protest in national capital's suburb of Noida as living costs across the world rise due to the Iran war.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/tear-gas-fired-at-indian-workers-demanding-higher-wage-as-living-costs-rise?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Factory workers protest in national capital's suburb of Noida as living costs rise, exacerbated by the Iran war and other economic factors."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Mediator exceptionalism narrative construction",
    "detail": "Framing one mediator country as uniquely capable due to special relationships while implying others failed.",
    "debias": "Report on mediation efforts without implying one country has exceptional capabilities others lack.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-13",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Pakistan has been under the spotlight as it managed what others couldn't due to its ties with the Gulf, US and China.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/how-the-us-iran-talks-in-islamabad-unfolded?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "Pakistan hosted the talks, leveraging its diplomatic relationships with the Gulf states, US and China."
  }
]
